description.zh: 战士在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Warrior talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【武器与狂怒 Beta 开荒】11 点全投狂怒系：5% 近战暴击、持续不断的额外怒气，以及 20 级的刺耳怒吼，逃跑的怪一个也跑不掉。 【防护 Beta 开荒】防护系的前 11 点全部围绕怒气：每次格挡回 5 点怒气，血性狂暴多给一半，雷霆一击更便宜，群拉更稳。
body.en: [Arms and Fury Beta Start] Eleven points into Fury: 5% melee critical strike, a steady stream of extra Rage, and Piercing Howl at 20 to stop anything that runs. [Protection Beta Start] Protection's first eleven points are all Rage: 5 Rage on every block, half again as much from Bloodrage, and a cheaper Thunder Clap for holding groups.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.

provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
